Kill [[Khabuus]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Kill Khabuus in [[Bogroot Growths]].
* *BONUS* Kill Khabuus in [[Hard Mode]]. 
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
*10,000 [[Experience]]
*1,500 [[Gold]]
*2,500 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]]
*Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
*Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per [[Giriff's War]].

==Dialogues==
===Initial dialogue===
'''[[Zaishen Bounty]]'''
:''"Kill Khabuus in Bogroot Growths." 
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = This despicable villain still stalks the land, preying on the innocent. Heroes who are up to the challenge should seek this fiend out, taking blood as payment for a life of atrocious deeds.}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*The [[Bogroot Chest]] will ''not'' appear, and this quest will not update, until Khabuus ''and'' the two Ophil allies with him are defeated.
